archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes a lockstep stall-report contract across code, TSV allowlists, docs, SECURITY, and structure tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the new bail_reason and integer-or-unknown exit_code reporting contract is consistent across the shell helper, TSV allowlist, markdown contract, SECURITY.md, and structure tests. Pay attention to enum lists, transform names, rendered table rows, and whether parity checks would catch drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.rationale: The change relies on subtle shell defaults and in-memory bail reason handoff through Step 2 into Step 18a.
